login.title: Welcome back!
login.subtitle: Sign in to access your space.
login.truthTitle: Both ways lead to the same place
login.truthBody: Google or email: same courses, same progress, same certificates. It isn't two accounts.

register.title: Create an account
register.subtitle: Join the Max-Morrys community for free.
register.truthTitle: Creating an account signs you up to nothing
register.truthBody: There's no checkbox on this screen, and that's not an oversight: I don't have a sending channel. No newsletter, no follow-up, no automated mail. Your address gets you in, and that's all it does.

reset.title: Forgot password
reset.subtitleDefault: Enter your email to reset your password
reset.subtitleSent: If an account exists at that address, the link is already there. Check your spam folder too.
reset.sentMessage: An email with a reset link has been sent to {{email}}.
reset.truthBody: I'll never tell you whether an address has an account. It looks less helpful, but it stops a stranger from testing addresses to find out who signed up.
reset.debtNote: This link depends on an email channel, which the product doesn't have yet.
